entities.summary: Lucas William Bradley Harrell is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago White Sox, Houston Astros, Atlanta Braves, Texas Rangers, and Toronto Blue Jays, and in the KBO League for the LG Twins.
